We definitely didn't regret our choice :)

The restaurant serves almost all of its courses tapas style -- small plates about the size of a deck of cards, which is how our server described it. A very shareable meal experience. 

The hummus was the highlight of my entire meal. It was the perfect way to start -- the hummus itself was rich in flavor and incredibly creamy. It paired very well with the laffa which was decently seasoned but not overwhelming. Each one of the salatim dishes had their own unique flavor which paired well with the laffa overall.

Service was alright.

Ordering is easy. You simply check off the quantity/types of meat you want off the menu and hand it to the waiter. 

The meats here are a bit on the pricier end, but very tender and delicious. The New Zealand lamb really hit the spot! Garlic beef was very flavorful but super clumpy chunks of meat when cooked in the broth. 

They don't offer an all-you-can-eat option unfortunately. I would say $18-25/per person is the average of what you could spend here to be full. 

The service is pretty quick. The atmosphere is bright and super spacious -- there's plenty of seating everywhere!
